scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed men sit facing one another on rocks beneath an olive tree. A dark-bearded man in a rust-colored mantle speaks with an open palm, while an older gray-bearded man listens. Warm ochre hills recede beneath a blue, clouded sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined conversation gives visible form to the request that Job hear the speaker and attend to all his words. The open palm and turned, attentive face express speaking and listening. Faces, clothing, olive tree and rocky landscape are illustrative choices, not details specified by this verse. The speaker is an ordinary human, not a portrayal of God.
